sectionsUsed: 3 Flex Layout Box Model and Terminology, 4 Flex Items: display flex makes an element a flex container and each in-flow child a flex item; main and cross axes. Page claims: teach step 2, direct children only (GIFT o1).

5.1 Flex Flow Direction, the flex-direction property: row | row-reverse | column | column-reverse, initial row; applies to flex containers. Page claims: direction builder, flex-direction does nothing without display flex.

7.1 The flex shorthand (initial 0 1 auto), 7.2 Components of Flexibility, 9.7 Resolving Flexible Lengths: free space distributed in proportion to flex grow factors; overflow removed in proportion to the scaled flex shrink factor (flex-shrink multiplied by the flex base size). Page claims: prediction, teach step 4, leftover space setups, apply question, GIFT o3.
8.2 Axis Alignment, justify-content (initial flex-start), 8.3 Cross-axis Alignment, align-items (initial stretch). Page claims: teach step 3 defaults, alignment builder.

5.1 justify-content and align-content, 6.3 align-items, 4.3 Distributed Alignment (space-between): positional and distributed alignment along the main and cross axes. Page claims: centre, space-between, flex-start in the alignment builder.

8 Gaps Between Boxes, the row-gap, column-gap and gap properties: gutters between adjacent items, not at the outer edges; apply to flex containers. Page claims: gap in teach step 3, goal 2, GIFT o2 gap at the edges.
